rows.proposedChange: Rewrite the criteria as: (1) In the opening run, the page's 'Back' link goes to Commodity details: give the animalIdentification step in flow/run.js backCandidates [consignmentDetailsPage.id], and have its controller use kit.runBackLink in place of hubPath. Criterion 2 waits on type-question-and-templates inc-156 reaching main. Opened from the Overview or Check your answers, the Back link and the save return already behave as they should on main. Keep the existing journey walk as the regression guard for them.

rows.evidence: Design snagging inc-214 (merged 23 Oct in 032c9ed8) changed which forms are read. On 'Save and add another' and 'Save and finish', only the pressed card's form is read: linesToReadFormsFor filters to `index === addIndex` (animal-identification/form/forms.js:87-95). Criterion 1 is met. withEmptyFormGuard's anyData check now looks only at that card (forms.js:135-136). So an empty dog card beside a filled cattle card is refused with 'Enter at least one identifier for this animal' on the dog card's first identifier field (forms.js:141-145; copy/copy.en.js:140). Nothing is saved, because the controller renders the refusal before appendLineRecords (animal-identification.controller.js:170-176). The message shows inline through the field's error (card/view-model.js visibleIdentifierFields, error: errors[fieldName(...)]), and the error summary links to `#<field>` (card/error-summary.js:11-15). Criterion 2 is met. The card's 'Save and finish' button is the same `add:<index>` button, labelled 'Save and finish' when one animal is left to enter (card/view-model.js:57-63; _identification-card.njk:58-64). So a blank last animal is refused by the same guard and stays to enter. Gap: no test proves either criterion. The only test is a single-card empty 'add:0' (animal-identification.controller.test.js:517-525). Neither the frontend nor the tests repo has a two-card case.
rows.proposedChange: Close as met. Alternatively, keep it as a tests-only proof row: a controller test, plus a fit test with cattle and dogs where only the cattle card is filled and the dog card's 'Save and add another' is pressed, and a test where a blank last animal's 'Save and finish' is pressed. No code change is expected.

rows.evidence: The block's stated reason was 'waits until pigs, sheep and goats reach the catalogue from MDM'. That no longer applies. EUDPA-617 'search MDM's commodities through reference-data' merged to frontend main on 27 Oct (c3183a8e, #422). Commodity search now reads MDM's live-animal species through reference-data, and the captured MDM fixture holds 0103 (services/_capture/fixtures/commodities.json:93), 010410 (:130) and 010420 (:151). The work this row asks for is still unbuilt. COMMODITY_IDENTIFIERS gives no identifiers to 0103, 010410 or 010420 (services/commodities/rules.js:6-18), so today these commodities skip Identification details altogether. The row's detail ('today's live-animal catalogue holds five commodities, none of them these') is out of date. Its external dependency, commodities-and-reason inc-012, is still marked blocked on the same MDM reason in that theme's backlog. Unblocking stays Sam's call: this verdict reports only that the stated reason has gone.

Still needed. No permanent address page exists on main or on any theme branch, in the frontend or the tests repo (no 'Add a permanent address', 'permanent-address' page or 'Permanent addresses added' anywhere). The backend's AnimalIdentifier carries only `ConsignmentParty permanentAddress` (AnimalIdentifier.java:20) and nothing for the same-as-destination choice, and no backend theme branch changes it. Ferrets (Mustela putorius furo) and other 01061900 species ('Carnivora excluding Canis familiaris, Felis catus, Mustela putorius furio') are now in the catalogue (fixtures/commodities.json:587, 383). The permanent-address rule already lists ferrets and 'Canis lupus familiaris' (services/commodities/rules.js:63-70). Fish is no longer a live-animal commodity: MDM's list has no 0301, and the stub uses ostriches in fish's place. So criterion 2's 'cattle, horses or fish' cannot be observed. splitReadyWhy: Not ready, for two reasons. First, two of the four themes it depends on are not on main. commodities-and-reason and type-question-and-templates are built only on their unmerged branches; journey-foundation and design-snagging are merged. Rows depend on work held there: inc-045 waits on inc-015 (the k6 walk, still todo in the commodities-and-reason backlog) and on inc-156 (template review, built on the type-question branch, not merged). inc-051 also waits on inc-012, which that theme's backlog still shows as blocked. Second, unbuilt or unmerged themes change this theme's code. commodities-and-reason edits flow/run.js (adding a second Back-link map beside main's backCandidates), commodities/fit/identification.fit.spec.js and commodities/copy. type-question-and-templates edits addresses/controller.js, addresses/template.njk, animal-identification.njk, shared/kit.js, flow/run.js and check-answers. overview-and-review rewrites the check-answers species cards that inc-056 changes; it is built on its branch and is itself meant to land after this theme. Inside the theme, every dependsOn is on a row in the same theme. inc-048 can be closed: main meets it, though no test proves it yet. inc-051's stated block (MDM catalogue) has gone with EUDPA-617, but it stays blocked until Sam rules.
